stories.description: Key findings from ADEX's State of Ad Fraud 2026 report, covering AI abuse, shifting suspension reasons, high-risk regions and 2027 predictions.

stories.title: When Risk Becomes Personal: What Security Leaders Can Learn From a Cancer Diagnosis
stories.description: Risk managers are trained to spot weak signals, plan for disruption and make hard decisions under uncertainty. But the discipline looks different when the risk is not a system or an enterprise, but you.

stories.title: Linux Kernel TCP Flaw With 9.8 CVSS Score Affects Ubuntu, Red Hat and Other Distributions
stories.description: Ubuntu and RHEL lack fixes for a Linux TCP use-after-free that Anthropic says it exploited to run commands as root on MPTCP servers.

stories.title: Fake ChatGPT and Claude Apps Abuse Signed Executables to Deploy Crypto Miners
stories.description: Fake ChatGPT and Claude desktop apps on GitHub use DLL sideloading to deploy YobaLoader, which retrieves and executes an XMRig miner.

stories.title: Claude AI Exploits Linux Kernel Flaw to Execute Root Commands Without User Interaction
stories.description: Anthropic says an unreleased Claude research model wrote a working exploit for a critical Linux kernel bug, tracked as CVE-2026-98432. The exploit lets a remote attacker run commands as root with no login and no user action.

stories.title: Google Touts Powerful Cybersecurity Capabilities in Gemini 4 Carbon Model
stories.description: Google’s new frontier model scored 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro and is rolling out first to vetted cyber defenders via its Fairwind Program.

stories.title: How Secure Are US Elections? Voting Machine Risks and the Growing Threat of AI
stories.description: Unpatched voting machines, unverifiable QR-coded ballots, and AI-driven influence campaigns leave US elections short of secure.

stories.title: NIST Officially Released Guidance for Transition to Post-Quantum Cryptography
stories.description: NIST issued guidance outlining quantum-resistant cryptography standards and migration timelines.

stories.title: Cisco Open Sources Quarry to Catch AI Agent Attacks Hidden in Harmless Steps
stories.description: Cisco open sourced Project Quarry, a rule language for detecting AI agent attacks that only emerge across sequences of benign actions.

stories.title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon Leads Benchmarks for Finding, Exploiting, and Patching Vulnerabilities
stories.description: Google unveils Gemini 4 Carbon with improved vulnerability detection, exploitation, and patching capabilities, initially for select cyber defenders.
